snippet.title: That Mountain Needs to Fall | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist That Mountain Needs to Fall now!

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5356450/That_Mountain_Needs_to_Fall/

Demo on Itch: https://convoyofbulls.itch.io/that-mountain-needs-to-fall

An incremental game about dwarves and mining. Send your dwarves against the mountain, watch the ore fly and turn a single house into an army of different dwarves. Call the heroes of Ragnarok, conquer the mountain, unleash Ragnarok and start over stronger with Odin's blessings.
